NEW YORK, Nov. 18, 2026
[NASDAQ: EXLS], a global data and AI company, announced that Everest Group has named EXL a Leader in its

params.linkText: 2026 Fraud Management Operations Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment

children: This recognition reflects EXL’s continued investment in AI-enabled fraud operations, advanced analytics, and deep financial services domain expertise to help financial institutions detect complex threats, accelerate investigations, and strengthen financial crime and compliance operations.

“As financial institutions contend with increasingly sophisticated fraud networks, synthetic identities, and rising dispute volumes, they are seeking providers that can combine advanced analytics with scalable, AI-enabled fraud operations and measurable business outcomes,” said Dheeraj Maken, vice president, Everest Group. “EXL differentiates itself through its deep data science and analytics expertise, supported by investments in EXLerate.ai™ and graph intelligence capabilities to strengthen fraud detection and investigations. Clients recognize its high-quality delivery, strong industry perspective, and ability to translate emerging AI innovations into tangible productivity and operational effectiveness improvements.”

“We’re proud to earn these recognitions, as they show our full commitment to providing our clients with a holistic strategy to address fraud, risk, and compliance,” Narasimha Kini, executive vice president, banking and capital markets and diversified industries at EXL. “We’ll continue investing in the data, AI, and domain expertise that help institutions stay ahead of the evolving financial crime.”

Everest Group evaluated 20 providers for fraud management operations services, assessing their ability to scale operations across transaction monitoring, alert review and investigations, and end-to-end fraud management. The assessment highlighted EXL’s growing agentic AI capabilities, established analytics expertise, and scaled fraud operations, supported by an expanding technology partner ecosystem.

EXL was also recognized as a Major Contender for the second consecutive year and named a Star Performer in the 2026 Financial Crime and Compliance (FCC) Operations Services PEAK Matrix Assessment. The FCC operations services assessment evaluated 37 providers across areas including know your customer, anti-money laundering, fraud management, charge back, and recovery as well as providers’ ability to incorporate automation and AI into service delivery.
Download the 2026 Fraud Management Operations Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment to learn more about EXL’s capabilities highlighted in the assessment.

About EXL
EXL

is a global data and AI company that offers services and solutions to reinvent client business models, drive better outcomes and unlock growth with speed. EXL harnesses the power of data, AI, and deep industry knowledge to transform businesses, including the world's leading corporations in industries including insurance, healthcare, banking and capital markets, retail, communications and media, and energy and infrastructure, among others.
